Role Title: Retail Customer Support Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Retail Customer Support Specialists to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating the customer experience in retail service interactions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Provide detailed feedback and evaluations on written and spoken retail support scenarios, focusing on realism and accuracy.
  2. Simulate authentic customer support interactions related to order processing, returns, refunds, deliveries, and complaint resolution.
  3. Contribute to data annotation projects by categorizing, tagging, and enriching customer support exchanges for AI training.
  4. Assess the effectiveness of AI-generated responses for retail customer inquiries, highlighting areas for improvement.
  5. Create and review scripts, prompts, or roleplay dialogues that reflect everyday challenges in retail customer support.
  6. Document common pain points, best practices, and process improvements based on your retail service background.
  7. Participate in voice recording or transcription activities to support voice-based AI training tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Professional experience in retail customer support or call center service, with a strong understanding of order, return, refund, and delivery processes.
  2. Demonstrated ability to resolve customer complaints with empathy, accuracy, and professionalism.
  3. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, including clear and articulate speech for voice-based tasks.
  4. Proven attention to detail when documenting and assessing customer interactions.
  5. Adaptability to new technologies and willingness to engage with innovative AI projects.
  6. Prior experience working in a remote consulting, freelance, or project-based capacity is advantageous.
  7. Enthusiasm for shaping future AI solutions by sharing practical, real-world retail support knowledge.
